Why 2024 “Text Pre-Training Wall” Takes Miss This:
Web-text scraping plateaued in late 2024, so labs moved compute into
build → render → inspect RL loops. Jumping +150 Elo from 6.0 to 6.2
put real 3D topology inside the weights—impossible for Haiku swarms.
